python3 -c "
import urllib.request, json, time, re

single_flighters = [
    'Duane G. Carey',
    'William C. McCool',
    'David M. Brown',
    'Charles Camarda',
    'Laurel Clark',
    'John Herrington',
    'Joan Higginbotham',
    'Lee Morin',
    'Lisa Nowak',
    'Paul W. Richards',
    'Philippe Perrin',
    'Gerhard Thiele'
]

for name in single_flighters:
    time.sleep(1)
    url = f'https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=parse&page={urllib.parse.quote(name)}&prop=wikitext&format=json'
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'AstronautResearchProject/1.0 (info@research.org)'})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
            data = json.loads(resp.read().decode('utf-8'))
            wikitext = data['parse']['wikitext']['*']
            time_match = re.search(r'time\s*=\s*(.*)', wikitext, re.IGNORECASE)
            mission_match = re.search(r'missions?\s*=\s*(.*)', wikitext, re.IGNORECASE)
            print(f'{name}:')
            if time_match:
                print('  time:', time_match.group(1))
            if mission_match:
                print('  missions:', mission_match.group(1))
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'{name}: ERROR {e}')
"
